method: Per-session official asset discovery; complete transcript/caption downloads and extraction; complete audio+video decode of original L01-L06 MP4s; one native-resolution frame inspected from each of L01-L06; exact linked weekly summaries downloaded/extracted, Week 1 all pages visually inspected, Week 14 text read; dependency passages reviewed per session. No lecture was semantically consumed in all modalities.
finding: Available original recordings are not equivalent to established complete source readability. Actual tools provide transcripts and extracted images, but this audit did not obtain a complete, validated visual/gesture reconstruction or independently listen to all audio. Sampling and ffmpeg decoding do not certify those channels. All 35 remain excluded pending that recovery.
important_corrections: Every session includes original video, even where the queue says transcript only.
All 35 original MP4 links returned HTTP 200 on final HEAD check; transient tunnel errors on L26-L33 cleared on one retry.
L34/L35 initially had transient source-page tunnel failures; retries downloaded page, PDF and VTT successfully.
The Week 14 summary linked from L34/L35 contains only Lecture 33, so it cannot count as review-lecture notes.
No alternate course offering was substituted.
